title.en: SAMPLE: A research council plans to ask applicants about AI use
title.zh: SAMPLE：研究委員會計畫詢問申請人使用 AI 的情形

found.en: The Aldgate Research Council published a draft rule on AI in grant proposals. Applicants would have to say if AI tools helped write any part of a proposal. The draft asks for this statement in the proposal summary only. Comments are open until the end of the year.
found.zh: Aldgate Research Council 公布了一份關於補助申請書使用 AI 的規則草案。依草案，申請人必須說明，AI 工具是否協助撰寫了申請書的任何部分。草案只要求在申請書摘要中提出這項說明。意見徵詢期開放到年底。

matters.en: Research councils decide who receives funding. A rule on AI use tells applicants what they must disclose, and it tells reviewers what they are reading. Other funders could copy a rule like this one, so its wording may matter far beyond one council.
matters.zh: 研究委員會決定誰能獲得經費。關於 AI 使用的規定，會告訴申請人必須揭露什麼，也告訴審查人他們讀到的是什麼。其他資助機構可能仿效這樣的規定，所以它的措辭，影響所及可能遠遠超出一個委員會。

ai_helped.en: No AI system is named in the draft. The rule is about AI tools in general: it covers any tool that helped write a proposal. The council asks applicants to say what help they had, not which tool gave it.
ai_helped.zh: 草案沒有指名任何 AI 系統。這項規定談的是一般的 AI 工具：凡是協助撰寫申請書的工具，都包含在內。委員會要求申請人說明得到了什麼協助，而不是哪個工具提供的。

how_sure.en: Claimed. The Aldgate Research Council states the draft in its own announcement. It is a proposal, not yet a rule, and the council may change it after the comment period closes. No other source we read says how the council will act.
how_sure.zh: 宣稱。Aldgate Research Council 在自己的公告中載明了這份草案。它只是提議，還不是正式規定，委員會可能在意見徵詢期結束後修改。我們讀過的其他來源，都沒有說明委員會會怎麼做。

background.en: Funding councils receive many proposals each year. Writers use many tools, from spell checkers to AI chatbots. A disclosure rule asks them to say what help they had.
background.zh: 補助委員會每年收到許多申請書。寫作者會用許多工具，從拼字檢查到 AI 聊天機器人都有。揭露規定要求他們說明得到了什麼協助。

could_lead.en: A final rule could set a pattern for other funders. It might also push applicants to hide their use of AI if the rule is unclear. Clear examples in the rule could prevent that.
could_lead.zh: 最終規定可能成為其他資助機構的範本。如果規定不清楚，也可能讓申請人隱瞞自己使用 AI。規定中若有清楚的例子，就可能避免這種情況。

evidence.quote: Applicants must say if AI tools helped write any part of a proposal

text.en: The council published its final rule. From 1 January, applicants must say if AI tools helped write any part of a proposal. The final rule covers every part of a proposal, not only the summary.
text.zh: 委員會公布了最終規定。從 1 月 1 日起，申請人必須說明 AI 工具是否協助撰寫了申請書的任何部分。最終規定涵蓋申請書的每個部分，不只是摘要。
